title: Satellite Forest Sector Count
description: Given a 2D grid matrix representing a region via satellite imagery, where '1' represents dense forest canopy and '0' represents barren land, compute the total number of distinct forest sectors. A forest sector is formed by connecting adjacent canopies horizontally or vertically.
output_format: An integer representing the count of distinct forest sectors.
